drafted_from: tool:find-my-x-account's own row (its words, input schema and steps) and the answer its test gives, a stand-in X answer with made-up ids; no live X call was made when this was written
start_here: Say to your AI: "Which X account is my connection on?", with {"account":"service_connection:x"}. It answers the account's id, username and name, and no post is read or changed.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Which X account is my connection on?", and give it account (Which of the person's X connections to ask, by its id).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:find-my-x-account and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read the id it hands back. The X listeners keep that id as their route key, so a bookmark or like source starts only once it is known.
